channel.description: The people of the GATAS Lab — current members, alumni, and mentees.

item.title: James Fairbanks
item.description: Principal investigator; assistant professor in Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering.

item.title: George Rauta
item.description: PhD student focused on numerical linear algebra and high-performance computing.

item.title: Richard Samuelson
item.description: Researching category theory, convex analysis, and high-performance computing.

item.title: Joana Bou Barcelo
item.description: PhD student in Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering applying cellular sheaves to multi-agent control.

item.title: Itay Kadosh
item.description: PhD student working on distributed coordination for multi-agent systems, with a background in robotics and computer vision.

item.title: Samuel Cohen
item.description: Undergraduate studying math and computer science; works on AlgebraicOptimization.jl.

item.title: Matt Cuffaro
item.description: Systems administrator and research programmer for the GATAS Lab.

item.title: Austin Copeland
item.description: PhD student in mechanical engineering, co-advised between the GATAS Lab and the Nonlinear Controls and Robotics group.

item.title: Liam Kunzendorf
item.description: Undergraduate in mechanical engineering working on Decapodes.jl.

item.title: Tyler Hanks
item.description: First GATAS PhD graduate; optimization, control theory, and machine learning.

item.title: Luke Morris
item.description: Leads development of CombinatorialSpaces.jl and Decapodes.jl.

item.title: Trevor Gross
item.description: Undergraduate in computer science working on AlgebraicOptimization.jl.

item.title: Wilmer Leal
item.description: Postdoctoral researcher working on categorical models of compositionality in chemistry.

item.title: Benjamin Merlin Bumpus
item.description: Led the algorithms subproject; now heads the CUÍCA lab at the University of São Paulo.

item.title: Kris Brown
item.description: Postdoctoral researcher who built much of the categorical rewriting and algebraic theory machinery in AlgebraicJulia.

item.title: Micah Halter
item.description: Research programmer on the lab's first modeling libraries, from SemanticModels through AlgebraicPetri.
